issue.title: bob plugins sync silently overwrites another agent's not-yet-committed plugin deploy
issue.description:
## Bug

`bob plugins sync` silently overwrites a vault plugin build that another agent deployed
but has not yet committed, so a landed fix can vanish from the vault with no drift
warning until the next lander happens to re-sync.

Reproduced twice in consecutive backlog batches:

- Batch 13 (bob-cli-cb): concurrent agent 14l deployed a pre-rebase bob-ledger-tools
  1.74.0 build at 12:23 that lacked bob-cli-cb's popout mark gates. The batch-13 lander
  found and redeployed it.
- Batch 14 (bob-cli-cf): phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.1 deployed
  bob-ledger-tools with the Pomodoro-ledger freshness guard at ~14:08 from an uncommitted
  tree (its commit 0bf8920 landed only at 14:42, after its turn). The Day-strip agent
  then rebased onto origin/master (which lacked the guard), built cc5d045, and synced
  bob-ledger-tools at ~14:33, erasing the guard from the vault. The batch-14 lander's
  `bob plugins sync --no-pull --dry-run` from master 35bda67 showed
  `bob-ledger-tools would copy main.js +63 -0`: exactly the missing
  `freshnessIsPomodoroLedgerLine` guard. `bob plugins list` reported drift only because
  master had moved on.

Root cause: deploys come from local, often uncommitted builds, and SASE agents commit
only after their turn. "Rebase onto origin/master before sync" (the batch-14 deploy rule)
cannot help, because the victim's change is not on origin yet. Nothing records what
the vault copy was built from, so a sync cannot tell "older than mine" from "newer
than master".

Fix direction (design needed): have `bob plugins sync` record a deploy stamp beside
each deployed plugin, for example `.bob-deploy.json` with the source repo, HEAD SHA, a
dirty-tree flag, a content digest, host, and time (keep it out of vault Git per
bob-cli-ch). Then refuse, or require `--force` for, an overwrite when the current
stamp came from a dirty or unpushed tree whose SHA is not an ancestor of the
deploying tree, and print who deployed it. `bob plugins list` should report "deployed
from uncommitted build" so landers can see it. Update docs/plugins sync docs and the
bob-plugins deployment page.

Found by the batch-14 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.land).

task_type_fields.impact: Landed fixes silently disappear from the live vault (batch 14 lost the Pomodoro-ledger freshness guard; batch 13 lost the popout mark gates) until someone re-syncs from master.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/plugins sync (bob plugins sync/list) and the bob-plugins deploy flow
task_type_fields.repro: Agent A builds a plugin from an uncommitted tree and runs bob plugins sync -p P; before A's commit lands, agent B rebases onto origin/master, builds P, and syncs it; A's change is gone from ~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/P/main.js and nothing warns.

issue.creation_reason: A deployed fix vanished from the vault in two consecutive backlog batches (cb, then cf) with no warning; only a lander's re-sync caught it.

payload.description: ch adds vault-ignore checks to the same plugins sync/list surface; a deploy stamp must stay git-ignored
